verdict.rationale: Undermind's enterprise page claims "Programmatic queries via API" with batch processing, and the GSK case study says GSK connects programmatically through a custom API. That is the product's own API capability, but it appears to be enterprise-gated, and no public reference documentation was found: OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The documented MCP endpoint belongs to the separate MCP-server story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: publicly documented API reference (endpoints, auth, schemas), self-serve API access outside enterprise or custom deals, an OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
